payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the criteria used to determine the steady state of soil parameters, referencing established studies and methodologies.

claims.text: The steady-state conditions for soil parameters were determined based on the criteria followed by Yang et al. (2005).
The study utilized airborne nitrogen deposition data until the soil parameters reached a steady state.
The site-scale spin-up details are available in Gahlot et al. (2020), which contributed to the steady state determination.
